http.note: GET the discovery files. Tool execution requires an open browser page; there is no remote HTTP POST or hosted MCP endpoint.

tools.name: chamber_get_capabilities
tools.description: Read API version, module types, geometry limits, export formats and tool schemas.

tools.name: chamber_get_state
tools.description: Read an independent copy of the current chamber configuration.

tools.name: chamber_load_config
tools.description: Replace the current chamber with a validated configuration. The change can be undone.

config.title: Chamber Studio version 1 configuration
config.description: Zero-based cells: columns 0–2, rows 0–7. Two-row modules occupy their anchor and the row below. Overlaps are rejected at runtime. Legacy rat poses normalize to stand; labels normalize to false.

tools.name: chamber_apply_operations
tools.description: Apply an ordered batch as one undo step. Add never overwrites a module; a failed operation leaves the entire chamber unchanged. Coordinates are zero-based. Update/remove/move may address either occupied row. Update accepts only options relevant to that module type.

tools.name: chamber_load_example
tools.description: Replace the layout with a bundled example. The change can be undone.

tools.name: chamber_undo
tools.description: Undo one layout change and return the restored configuration.

tools.name: chamber_redo
tools.description: Redo one layout change and return the restored configuration.

tools.name: chamber_export
tools.description: Export a snapshot of the current chamber. Returns a base64 file by default; download=true triggers a browser download and returns metadata. JSON retains configuration, SVG/PDF are vector, PPTX has editable native shapes. PNG scale is 1, 2 or 3. Includes rat artwork attribution.
